Hi Amy,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — appreciate you and Sam taking the time. Per our discussion I wanted to summarize the key compliance items Lumera asked about and propose a short mutual action plan so both teams are aligned.

Ask summary (items needed from Lumera):
- SOC 2: most recent report or readiness statement (Type II preferred; if in progress, a letter describing scope and timeline is fine).
- GDPR/HIPAA: confirmation whether Lumera requires a DPA/BBA and any specific data residency constraints.
- Incident response: official breach notification timeline (e.g., 72-hour window), primary IR contact, and SSO/mfa controls used for vendor portals.
- BCP/DR evidence: high-level runbook or proof points (table-top exercise dates, RTO/RPO targets, and the owner of the process).
- Vendor security questionnaire: I attached our Vendor Security Questionnaire v2 for your security team to start — a completed workbook will speed procurement.

Proposed mutual action plan:
1) You send SOC2/readiness letter + IR contact and BCP artifacts by Tue 2026-04-21.
2) Redwood will share our standard DPA and SOC2 scoping notes and assign an engineer for an optional security deep-dive call w/ your security team (30–45 min).
3) Procurement — once questionnaire is returned we can provide an initial commercial redline and draft SOW.

Attachments: Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_V2.xlsx (workbook, please return with answers in the "Security Team" tab).

Are these timelines workable? If helpful I can loop in our legal ops (Neha) and infra lead (Dev) on the next call.

Best,

Hi Soojin — thanks for the clear recap.

Quick answers and what I can share now:
- SOC 2: We're currently in the tail end of our Type II audit; I attached our SOC2-readiness-letter that outlines scope and expected issuance in late May. I can share the full report as soon as it's published.
- GDPR/HIPAA: Lumera is HIPAA-regulated for PHI; we require a BAA for any service touching PHI. For GDPR, standard DPA language is usually sufficient but we have one regional data residency constraint for EU-based customers (not relevant for this POC).
- Incident response: Our contract requires notification within 72 hours of confirmed breach; however initial detection notices often precede confirmation — we'll provide a primary IR contact for vendor coordination below.
- BCP/DR: High-level runbook exists; I'll ask our Ops team for a 1–2 page summary and a table of most recent exercise dates.

IR contact:
- Security triage: security@lumerahealth.com (responses escalate to on-call)
- Primary lead: Javier Morales (javier.morales@lumerahealth.com)

Timeline: I should be able to get the readiness letter + the 1–2 page BCP summary to you by Tue 2026-04-21. Our security team will take the Vendor Security Questionnaire; please expect a response within 7–10 business days once they receive it.

Note on procurement: Our procurement team will need the completed questionnaire and a copy of Redwood's standard DPA/BAA. I cc'd Sam for procurement coordination.

Thanks — attaching the readiness letter now.

-Amy
